description: This file defines the class Image_Graph_Layout_Matrix, which manages a matrix layout for graphical elements in the Image_Graph library, including methods for constructing, setting, retrieving, and rendering matrix elements.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Layout_Matrix
classes.description: A layout class for arranging elements in a matrix grid, with automatic edge pushing and rendering capabilities.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Layout_Matrix
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the matrix with specified rows and columns, optionally auto-creating plot areas.

methods.name: _pushEdges
methods.description: Private method to set edge positions for a cell in the matrix.

methods.name: getEntry
methods.description: Retrieve the element at a specific row and column in the matrix.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Set an element at a specific row and column in the matrix and push its edges.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Update coordinates of all elements in the matrix layout.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Render the layout to the canvas, returning success status.
